chunks: Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Ibn Bukayr, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Verily in Hell there is a valley for the arrogant ones which is called Saqar. It complained to Allah about the intensity of its heat and asked Him to permit it to respire, so He permitted it and when it exhaled, it burnt [the entirety of] Hell.

key_terms.سَقَرُ: Saqar (a specific name for a valley or layer of Hell)

ai.seo_question: What is the valley of Saqar in Hell and who is it for?
ai.summary: In this unique tradition from *Kitab al-Zuhd*, the valley of Saqar is personified as a sentient entity suffering from the intensity of its own fire, ultimately asking Allah for permission to breathe out. Upon exhaling, its breath becomes so potent that it consumes or burns the entirety of Hell, illustrating the overwhelming power of divine creation even within the realm of punishment. This narrative underscores the concept of *Tajalli* (divine manifestation) within the afterlife, where the attributes of Allah are reflected in the very geography of Paradise and Hell.

en.shaykh-tahir-ridha-jaffer: 14.Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr narrated from Ibn Bukayr, from Abū ʿAbdillāh (a) who said, “

Verily in Hell there is a valley for the arrogant ones which is called Saqar. It [once] complained to Allah about the intensity of its heat and asked Him to permit it to respire, so He permitted it and when it exhaled, it burnt [the entirety of] Hell.”
